cachedTools.name: get_hot_search
cachedTools.description: Get current trending topics / hot searches from major Chinese social media platforms (Weibo, Zhihu, Douyin, Bilibili). Returns a ranked list with titles and popularity scores. Results are cached for 10 minutes. Use this when the user asks about trending topics, hot news, what people are talking about, or wants to know what is popular right now.

platform.description: Which platform to query. "weibo" = 微博熱搜, "zhihu" = 知乎熱榜, "douyin" = 抖音熱榜, "bilibili" = B站熱門. Use "all" to get top items from all 4 platforms in parallel.

limit.description: Max items to return per platform (default 20, max 50)
